reason: The lab report with a batch number I can check and the money-back guarantee take most of the risk out, and $24.99 for the first box is a fair test price. I would buy one box, not two, and see if it actually helps me wind down.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other brands put 8 forms in one capsule? I would want to know bisglycinate alone is enough, and I am not paying $29.99 every month for something I could not tell was working.
would_change_my_mind: If the launch price were gone and it was $29.99 with no coupon or bundle, I would wait for a TikTok Shop flash sale instead.
